title: Pick a Card: The 7 of Hearts Mind Hack

vo.en: Pick a playing card right now.

visual.description: Close-up shot of a dealer's hands quickly cutting and riffling a deck of cards over a dark table.

vo.en: Picture it clearly in your head. Make it a red card, hearts or diamonds.

visual.description: A crimson neon heart glowing and reflecting across rain-slicked city pavement at night.

vo.en: Now eliminate face cards. Lock in an odd number between two and ten.

visual.description: Fast mechanical tally counter numbers spinning rapidly through digits in macro focus.

vo.en: Wait, do not change your mind now! I already know your exact pick.

visual.description: Extreme macro close-up of a man's eye with the pupil suddenly dilating under intense studio light.

vo.en: Your subconscious feels free, but you are staring right at the seven of hearts.

visual.description: A single playing card being dramatically flipped face up onto a dark rustic wooden table.

vo.en: Subtle psychological priming silently forces seventy percent of human minds to this card.

visual.description: Glowing electric blue and purple neural pathways firing synapses across an abstract 3D brain structure.

vo.en: Subscribe for tomorrow's brain test and comment YES if this got you, which is why I dare you to

visual.description: First-person view of a man's hand typing rapidly and tapping the glass screen of a modern smartphone.
